name: The primary contact is selected by person
title: SC-12-05-05 The primary contact is selected by person
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a unit whose household includes a person
When the manager selects that person as primary contact
Then the unit stores the person as primary contact
And a person who is not on the unit is refused
